name: Floor Scrubber Squeegee Blade
definition: A floor-scrubber squeegee-blade profile covers the front and rear elastomer blades, material, edge geometry, length, holes, notches and mounting position that seal the recovery airflow path; it does not make blades interchangeable by length or color.
includedScope: Natural rubber, polyurethane, Linatex and named manufacturer materials
Front and rear position, blade profile, edge, hole and machine or deck checks
Walk-behind, stand-on and ride-on scrubber-dryer recovery systems
excludedScope: Complete squeegee-tool assemblies unless explicitly cited
headline: Length alone does not establish fit—material, profile, hole pattern, front or rear position and exact machine scope all matter.
description: This profile separates squeegee materials, recovery behavior and exact machine or deck checks so buyers can compare documented replacement blade families without assuming universal fit.
metaDescription: Floor scrubber squeegee blade materials, front and rear profiles, dimensions, chemical boundaries, recovery symptoms and compatibility checks.
disclaimer: Physical resemblance, matching wattage, matching voltage, a generic family name or a seller claim does not establish compatibility. Verify the current manufacturer part number and revision, machine model and serial scope, electrical and control specification, mechanical and fluid or airflow interfaces, protection requirements and approved service documentation.
